overall: The AG found the Greenfield School Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating through email outside a posted meeting, resolved by informal action with no further remedy because the emails were already released publicly; ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the school committee deliberated outside a posted meeting through email exchanges among its members.
allegations.key_passage: and find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law as alleged

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of intent to violate.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution the Committee that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
